duration.text: The Mechatronic engineering at Huzhou University is a 4 Years long program for international students, taught in English.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 2083 USD/per year ￥ 15000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1) An electronic passport photo (white background)2) Scanned copy of passport (the photo page)3) Copy of your highest degree Academic Transcript (Notarized English or Chinese translation)4) Copy of your highest degree certificate (Notarized English or Chinese translation)5) IELTS (5.5 or above) certificate or English language proficiency certificate (English medium programs applicants must provide)HSK level 4 (180 or above) certificate (Chinese medium programs applicants must provide)6) Medical Report (Notarized English or Chinese translation)7) Certificate of Non-criminal Record (Notarized English or Chinese translation)8）Family financial statement (Minimum 5000 USD, Notarized English or Chinese translation)9）Study plan (Chinese or English version)10) Reference (Chinese or English version)

requirements.text: 1) Foreign citizens with senior high school degree or equivalent degrees, no criminal record, aged 18-25, in good health condition and in accordance with the Health Standard for International Students stipulated by the Ministry of Education, China.2) Good moral character and obey the laws and regulations of the Chinese government and the university, respect Chinese customs and habits. 3) Good academic performance, English language proficiency IELTS (5.5 or above) English proficiency with official stamps if study English taught bachelor program; Chinese language proficiency HSK-4 (180 or above) if study Chinese taught bachelor program.
